symptom: `marketplace update 109515 --to 5.2.1` refused an untouched NanoflowCommons with "refusing to update: 44 element(s) have been changed locally and the update would discard them: JAVASCRIPT_ACTION Base64Decode ..."; `marketplace diff` showed "Locally modified (44 of 50 elements)", every one a JavaScript action (mendixlabs/mxcli#1441). Only on a repeat run of a version - the first diff, a cache miss, was clean.
cause: The finished-reference cache stored the model only: isModelFile dropped javascriptsource/ and javasource/ as 'never read'. DESCRIBE JAVASCRIPT/JAVA ACTION reads <dir>/<Module>/actions/<Name>.{js,java} beside the .mpr and prints a 'source not available' placeholder when absent, so a cache MISS compared real code against real code and a cache HIT compared the placeholder against the project's code - every action Modified. The filter's own comment warned of exactly this ('anything that starts reading a sibling directory ... will see it on a cache miss and not on a hit').
file: cmd/mxcli/marketplace/refcache.go (isModelFile keeps javascriptsource/ + javasource/; refEntryFormat 'f2' prefix in refCacheDir so pre-fix model-only entries are never served), cmd/mxcli/marketplace/snapshot.go (Conclusive: omitted-source placeholder -> Unknown, never Modified); tests cmd/mxcli/marketplace/refcache_sources_test.go, refcache_test.go, inconclusive_test.go
insight: **A cache bug that only shows on the second run needs a miss-then-hit test, not a hit test.** The decisive test snapshots the same untouched module against the fresh reference and then against the cache-restored one; the miss half passing proves the fixture is sound, the hit half failing locates the cache. Assert Unchanged, not 'not Modified': with the placeholder gate in place the old filter yields Unknown, which still blocks `update` without --force - the control showed exactly that. **A cache-content change needs a key change**: an old entry is complete by its own marker and would keep serving the stripped tree for ever, so the fix versions the entry name (refEntryFormat) instead of trusting a filter change to reach existing caches. **A placeholder is not content**: DESCRIBE output that substitutes a 'not available' body for data must be inconclusive in the diff, else a missing file reads as an edit. Controls: old filter -> hit reports 'unknown' (gate kept) / 'modified' (gate off); unprefixed key -> legacy entry served.
